svg.title: The plateau question is mostly unanswered on ClinicalTrials.gov
svg.desc: 22 ClinicalTrials.gov studies of what to do when a GLP-1 drug stops working or you want to keep the weight off, by purpose, with vs without posted results: switch to a newer drug 8 (1 with results, in type 2 diabetes); switch or step down to hold weight 6 (0); add something for a poor response 2 (0); after quitting the drug 2 (0); go above the usual top dose 4 (2, both semaglutide 7.2 mg). Seven of the 22 were first posted since September 1, 2026. Of 33 retatrutide intervention studies, none is built for people coming off semaglutide or tirzepatide and 16 exclude recent weight-loss drugs.
